subject: [PATCH v5 00/11] Virtual Swap Space (Swap Table Edition)

reviews.author: Nhat Pham
reviews.summary: Clarified the motivation behind prototyping the conversion from xarray to VM_SPARSE vmalloc array, stating that it's a straightforward and simple process. Emphasized that Baoquan should drive this change if performance wins are demonstrated.

2026-09-18.patch_summary: This patch series introduces Virtual Swap Space (vswap) support, which allows for efficient allocation and management of swap space. The patches refactor the existing swap code to use a new data structure, VM_SPARSE vmalloc array, instead of xarray. This change aims to simplify the conversion from xarray to VM_SPARSE if needed in the future. The series also includes various cleanups, bug fixes, and performance improvements.
